narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video features a dermatologist sharing her personal history with severe acne to empower viewers to find self-worth beyond physical appearance. By showing her high school self and discussing how her academic success shielded her from bullying, she positions character and intelligence over vanity, ultimately building brand trust for her clinic.
